purpose: Continuously turn the 561 Group public estate into accurately discoverable, attributable, and measurable media without creating a separate GEO content mill.
monitor: enumerate public properties and changed public artifacts since the previous cycle
read each property's authority boundary and publication-discovery manifest
ingest available first-party crawl/index/search/AI citation/referral/conversion telemetry
run bounded representative query sets for entity, topic, navigational, informational, comparative, and commercial intents where appropriate
record observations separately for entity resolution, retrieval, mention, citation, prominence, factuality, freshness, referral, and conversion
select a versioned three-domain scientific query panel with branded, unbranded and unrelated entity controls; declare locales, surfaces, repetitions, snapshots and windows before measurement
analyze: distinguish publication defects from measurement gaps and platform variance
identify entity collisions, orphaned authority, missing canonical relationships, thin topic coverage, stale facts, unsupported claims, and correction drift
compare observed answer/citation behavior with the publication's own canonical facts and audience intent
prefer existing strong first-party artifacts over manufacturing new pages

retain separate within-surface evidence for topical relevance, target-entity confusion, citation URL correctness, demonstrated claim accuracy and scholarly release-status misrepresentation; absence from a response is not a demonstrated retrieval failure
plan: rank changes by end-user consequence, cross-property reuse, evidence strength, and cost
route each remediation to the owning publication or shared publishing primitive
choose the smallest change that can falsifiably improve the broken layer
never plan a GEO-only rewrite when ordinary technical/content/evidence repair addresses the cause

treat accepted mathematical proof/publication affordances differently from agentics software documentation and AI research explainers; select the current canonical producer and public receiver for each type
execute: make authorized low-risk fixes directly in the owning repository
add or repair canonical identity, structured data, sitemaps, feeds, topic relations, internal links, correction propagation, and crawler access where evidenced
open/update the receiving pull request and carry it through checks/review as far as authority permits
for blocked writes, update the existing blocker with an exact patch and acceptance test rather than spawning duplicate diagnosis

invoke the original query panel compiler only to emit observation requests; write actual source-backed observations to the existing ledger, and correct original authored metadata or accepted paper pages through competent owners
knowledge: append dated observations and before/after query evidence
update property manifests only after a capability is actually observed
retain failed experiments and platform-specific findings
promote reusable successful fixes into shared publishing infrastructure
feed proven techniques and measured economics downstream to Causeway AI Visibility Assurance

compare versioned pre/post query observations with stable controls, unchanged time windows where possible, platform/locale stratification and disclosed uncertainty; never count proposed queries as observed responses
publicationChangeTrigger: Any new publication, material redesign, domain/canonical change, major topic expansion, correction/retraction, product/service launch, or sustained answer/citation shift reopens the relevant layers.
success: The media estate becomes more accurately discoverable and citeable while preserving publication integrity; success is evidenced layer-by-layer, never by a single GEO score.

consumerProtocol.science: Lenticule distinguishes conjectures, accepted paper versions, Lean/kernel proofs and reproducible datasets; no scholarly markup that fabricates status, peer review or DOI.
consumerProtocol.engineering: Red Cup implements and verifies canonical HTML, stable versions, Scholar tags, proper structured data, Signposting links and sitemaps in the current original renderer rather than a GEO-only parallel CMS.
consumerProtocol.operations: Coesite and Causeway reconcile discovered defects and measured gains with provider deployments, publisher rights, Search Console/Bing Webmaster evidence and independent receiving.
consumerProtocol.acceptance: One native authored fix linked to an observed problem, qualifying tests and original deployment readback, then independent source-bound search/answer or user task evidence. Source-only improvements are not indexed visibility.
